biotools.summary: Castl is an ensemble-based framework designed for the robust identification of spatially variable genes (SVGs) in spatially resolved transcriptomics. It integrates multiple detection methods to mitigate algorithm-specific biases and effectively control false discovery rates (FDRs).
biotools.name: Castl: Ensemble-based SVG Identification
